title: Your language
caption: He thinks in Swahili and scrolls in English. Joseph switches on Waypoint's languages. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text:
Most apps ask people to read in a language that is not their first.

Waypoint works in 16 languages, and a post written in another language can be translated with one tap, or automatically. The founder character tells Joseph's story; every screen is the real app.

cast.joseph: Joseph, a young Kenyan man in his twenties with short hair, a green polo shirt and a student backpack

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera in a busy colourful street market in the afternoon, a warm smile.
